text: Pestana Palm Gardens is a resort of villas and apartments on the coast just east of Carvoeiro, and Pestana's own Carvoeiro courses, [Gramacho](/courses/gramacho) and [Vale da Pinta](/courses/vale-da-pinta), are about **12 minutes** away. The 9-hole par-3 [Vale de Milho](/courses/vale-de-milho) is about 3 minutes away, and Pestana Ferragudo, Silves and Amendoeira are all within about 25. **Last checked: November 2026.**

text: The nearest courses at a glance
Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer.
**[Vale de Milho](/courses/vale-de-milho)** (9 holes, par 27, 926 m): a short par-3 course in Carvoeiro, €22 a round, with no handicap needed.
**[Gramacho](/courses/gramacho)** (par 72, 6,107 m, slope 132): Pestana's hillier Carvoeiro course, next to Vale da Pinta. Twilight is €55 from 3.30pm.
**[Vale da Pinta](/courses/vale-da-pinta)** (par 71, 6,127 m, slope 132): Pestana's Carvoeiro course with rolling fairways. Twilight is €55 from 3.30pm.
**[Pestana Ferragudo](/courses/pestana-ferragudo)** (par 72, 5,841 m, slope 118): Pestana's newest course, opened in 2026, and one of the easiest 18-hole courses in the area on slope.
**[Silves](/courses/silves)** (par 70, 5,592 m, slope 120): a shorter, gentler Pestana course among orchards, with more slopes on the back nine, where a buggy is recommended.

**[Amendoeira Faldo](/courses/amendoeira-faldo)** (par 72, 6,598 m, slope 142): Nick Faldo's course climbs the hillside and is one of the hardest in the area. The online green fee includes a buggy, if one is available.

**[Amendoeira O'Connor](/courses/amendoeira-oconnor)** (par 72, 6,708 m, slope 136): Christy O'Connor Jr.'s sister course stays flat in the valley among orange groves, with the same buggy-included green fee.

**[Penina Championship](/courses/penina-championship)** (par 73, 6,273 m, slope 143): Cotton's 1966 course, the first in the Algarve, which the club says has hosted the Portuguese Open ten times. Flat, but the hardest course in the area on slope.
Golf at Pestana Palm Gardens

Pestana calls the resort Pestana Palm Gardens Ocean & Golf Villas, and its website says guests get **exclusive benefits and discounts at Vale da Pinta and Gramacho**, Pestana's two Carvoeiro courses about 10 minutes away, which also have a clubhouse and a golf academy. The page doesn't say what the discounts are, so ask the resort when you book, at palm.gardens@pestana.com.

Studios start from about €49 a night on Pestana's website, with its Guest Club discount, which makes it one of the more affordable ways to stay near the Pestana courses. There's a gym, sauna and tennis court, free for guests.

text: Which course to play from Pestana Palm Gardens
**For the guest discounts,** play Vale da Pinta and Gramacho. Read [Gramacho vs Vale da Pinta](/guide/gramacho-vs-vale-da-pinta-which-pestana-carvoeiro-course-should-you-play).
**For a quick or beginner-friendly round,** Vale de Milho is 3 minutes away, costs €22 and doesn't ask for a handicap.

**For more Pestana golf,** Silves and the new Pestana Ferragudo are about 20 minutes away. See [Silves vs Pestana Ferragudo](/guide/silves-vs-pestana-ferragudo-the-established-course-and-the-brand-new-one).
Getting there

Pestana Palm Gardens is about **57 minutes and 66 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. See [Faro Airport to Carvoeiro and Silves for golfers](/guide/faro-airport-to-carvoeiro-and-silves-for-golfers) and [hotels near Pestana Carvoeiro golf](/guide/hotels-near-pestana-carvoeiro-golf).
Golf near Pestana Palm Gardens: common questions
Which golf courses are near Pestana Palm Gardens?
Vale de Milho is about 3 minutes away, Gramacho and Vale da Pinta about 12, Pestana Ferragudo about 21 and Silves about 22.
Do Pestana Palm Gardens guests get golf discounts?
Pestana says guests get exclusive benefits and discounts at Vale da Pinta and Gramacho, without giving the details on its website. Ask the resort when you book.
Do I need a handicap to play near Pestana Palm Gardens?

At the 18-hole courses, yes, usually up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. Vale de Milho doesn't ask for one. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
